entries.4f0bfffc6d4018dd: Distributes fortune-telling readings and article content for women on its own sites and on platforms such as telecommunications carriers, and also provides phone and chat fortune-telling and social interaction services.
entries.56da92d5d20c5977: This business provides 1-to-N services that plan, produce and distribute fortune-telling readings and articles for women to its own Web site, ISPs, mobile carriers and platforms such as Apple and Google, as well as 1-to-1 services in which users and fortune tellers interact directly by phone or chat. Fortune-telling content is produced with fortune tellers' supervision from the planning stage. It is mainly handled by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Giftcom Japan Co., Ltd. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥1,761 million.
entries.62fa622d30095d52: A business that provides services centered on SNS, offering opportunities and venues for people to interact and build relationships both online and offline. It operates the exchange service “Kyaraden” and the Akasaka-Mitsuke store of the simulation golf venue “LoungeRange.” It is mainly handled by consolidated subsidiaries Mix Base Co., Ltd. and Xsquare Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥109 million.
